items.title: Workspace instructions
items.body:
# Core platform

a-intel/platform is a TypeScript monorepo: the API in apps/api, the web app in apps/web, and shared code in packages/.

## Commands
- Use pnpm for every script. Node 22.
- Run one test file for what you changed: pnpm vitest run <file>.
- Lint only the files you touched: pnpm eslint <files>.

## Changes
- Never push to main. Open a pull request.
- A pull request names the issue it closes and the test that proves it.
- Keep a pull request to one change.

## Style
- Errors say what happened, then what to do.
- No new dependency without a line in the pull request saying why.

items.label: Release notes format
items.text: Release notes group changes by surface, not by author. Every entry links the pull request.

items.label: A person merges releases
items.text: Never merge a release pull request. A person merges it.

items.label: Use the retry helper
items.text: Use the workspace's retry helper, not an ad hoc loop.

items.label: No secrets in output
items.text: Never print a secret, a token or a connection string, even in part.

items.label: Migrations ship with the change
items.text: A schema change ships with its migration in the same pull request.

items.label: Safari e2e flake
items.text: The checkout e2e suite flaked on Safari through August. A retry there is not evidence of a regression.

items.label: Review comment format
items.text: A review comment names the line, the problem and the fix. No praise and no summaries.

items.label: Vitest, not Jest

prs.title: Memory PR, 2026-09-25
prs.summary: The curator read 22 candidates from 14 sessions. It merged 9 duplicates, dropped 5 that an active record already says, and held 4 below 2 distinct sessions. These 4 remain.

memories.text: The CI cache key hashes pnpm-lock.yaml. Update the lockfile with any dependency change, or CI restores a stale cache and typecheck fails.
Release notes for a-intel/cli come from the cli milestone, not the platform milestone.
billing-service tests need BILLING_FAKE_STRIPE=1, or they call Stripe's test API and time out.
The checkout e2e suite stopped flaking on Safari after 2026-09-12. Treat a Safari failure there as a real failure.

checks.note: Memories load when relevant, at most 5 and 800 tokens a request. They add nothing to the always-on total.

checkNames.schema: Fails when a file does not match its JSON Schema.
checkNames.lineage: Fails when two files share a lineage.
checkNames.hash: Fails when a stamped id or hash does not match the content.
checkNames.secrets: Fails when a secret or personal data appears in a file.
checkNames.conflicts: Fails when an active record requires what this one forbids.
checkNames.authority: Fails when a record tries to grant authority.
checkNames.settings: Fails when the repository settings differ from the prescribed ones.
checkNames.references: Fails when a named tool, record, repository, credential, or skill file does not exist.
checkNames.budget: Fails when the change pushes an agent's always-on steering over a budget.
checkNames.compile: Fails when a server folder does not compile, its lock does not match, or a policy test fails.
checkNames.owned: Fails when the change edits a file oxagen writes.

steps.fix: An organization admin grants Administration write to the app in GitHub, then you retry. Every step is safe to repeat.
